# sreagent_data_sources (Data Source)

Every data_source row, read-only. A metrics, logs or cloud data source investigations query.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sreagent_data_sources" "all" {}

output "data_sources_count" {
  value = length(data.sreagent_data_sources.all.items)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource key the list was read from.
- `items` (Attributes List) The rows. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `truncated` (Boolean) True when the API returned as many rows as its cap and may hold more.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `auth_credentials_set` (Boolean) Whether the platform holds a value for auth_credentials.
- `auth_type` (String) How the platform authenticates. Changing it to a type that takes credentials needs auth_credentials_wo with a new auth_credentials_wo_version in the same apply, because the stored credentials belong to the previous type.
- `aws_account_id` (String) The AWS account the source reads.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether investigations query it.
- `id` (String) The row's identifier on the platform.
- `name` (String) Unique within the organization.
- `regions` (List of String) AWS regions this source covers.
- `role_arn` (String) The role an aws_assume_role source assumes.
- `type` (String) prometheus, loki, cloudwatch and so on. Changing it replaces the source.
- `url` (String) The endpoint; derived for AWS types.
